Scene 03

ELLICOT, NEW YORK

Leyla Harrison

I asked that the body be sent to D.C. It was found in the woods about 50 yards beyond the house. Maybe we should begin there.

Leyla Harrison

Okay, then. The deceased is arlen sacks, aged 72 caretaker for the estate on which this house is situated. There were no signs of physical trauma but local pd suspect homicide due to the dumping of the body. Mr. Sacks was confined to a wheelchair the last few months cared for since then by his son, gary who's their chief suspect.

John Doggett

Leyla Harrison

Um... Oh, because he's missing, too.

John Doggett

Leyla Harrison

John Doggett

Leyla Harrison

John Doggett
